name: Philippines WSF integrated export
description: Custom indicators for mPhilGEPS WSF (APP + PR + bid + award) integrated flat export

indicators.name: APP milestone slippage
indicators.description: Planned APP milestone dates vs actual notice/award dates.
indicators.tracks: Slippage between APP planned milestones and executed procurement dates.

steps: Match milestone types (Advertisement, Submission, Notice of Award) to dueDate.
Compare to tender/tenderPeriod dates and awards/date.
Flag milestones where actual dates exceed planned by threshold.

indicators.interpretation: Planning integrity signal independent of bidder disclosure.

indicators.name: ABC vs APP line budget gap
indicators.description: Row-level ABC far below APP line estimated budget (apply at process level after grouping).
indicators.tracks: Mismatch between approved budget (ABC) and APP line estimated budget.

steps: Sum tender/value/amount across line items per process (bid_ref + PE).
Flag when ABC is far below APP line budget.

indicators.interpretation: Often line-item grain artifact; group before flagging.
indicators.limitations: ~17% false-positive rate at row grain on WSF sample.

indicators.name: APP milestone order invalid
indicators.description: APP milestone due dates in illogical order (e.g. award before bid opening).
indicators.tracks: Whether APP schedule milestones follow expected procurement sequence.

computation.summary: dueDate(Notice of Award) < dueDate(Submission of Bids) or similar inversions
steps: Order planning/milestones by type (Advertisement → Submission → Award).
Flag inverted or equal dates where sequence is required.

indicators.interpretation: Data quality or planning integrity issue before slippage analysis.

indicators.name: Material APP line without funding source
indicators.description: High APP budget line missing source of funds.
indicators.tracks: Budget law compliance — funding source on material APP lines.

computation.summary: planning/budget/amount ≥ threshold AND source of funds absent
steps: Read planning budget amount and source fields.
Apply value threshold for material lines.
Flag missing source_funds on high-value APP items.

indicators.interpretation: Cannot verify appropriation linkage for large planned spends.

paths.note: Source funds via planning budget block

indicators.name: Material APP line without PAP code
indicators.description: High-value APP line missing project ID (PAP code).
indicators.tracks: Linkage of procurement to approved program (PAP).

steps: Flag material lines without program linkage.

indicators.interpretation: Audit teams cannot trace spend to an approved program.

indicators.name: Award row without buyer UACS
indicators.description: Integrated row with award value but missing stable buyer identifier (UACS).
indicators.tracks: Agency linkage on WSF rows with contract amounts.

steps: Flag rows that cannot be attributed to a procuring entity.

indicators.interpretation: Compile or data-quality issue — WSF expects ~99.8% UACS fill.
